submission.natural_language_explanation: N1499- reads out the neuron's GELU dip: its strength is |GELU(z)| of the pre-activation, so it saturates at 0.170 (GELU's exact floor) whenever z sits near -0.75 and returns to ~0 on both sides of that band, which is why all twenty top examples tie at 0.170 and why the same word reads 0.17 in one context and 0.00 in another. z is driven by phrase-boundary/functional material rather than by referential content: it drops into the band on an attached sentence-final period '.' or a newline '\r\n', and on prepositions/conjunctions (' of', ' in', ' and', ' or', ' to', ' from', ' on', ' by'), while it stays above the band on self-standing referential or technical tokens (pronouns/demonstratives such as 'this/those/you/it', determiner+noun compounds such as 'the cat', 'data science', 'pdf docx'); consequently any passage of running prose, code or non-Latin text of ~5+ tokens is active at 0.8-1.0 of max, and a probe is silent only when it is a short (2-6 token) punctuation-free phrase built from such referential/technical tokens.

rival_explanations: Boundary-only reading: the negative pole is purely a sentence/line-end detector, so only clause-final punctuation or a newline can put it in the dip and the preposition/function-word peaks in the top examples are arbitrary tie-band members; it should therefore be silent on a punctuation-free sentence whatever its words, e.g. on 'The cat sat on the mat' (measured 0.69 of max, i.e. active, so this reading loses that probe).

Content-free dial reading: the pole is a default-on GELU-dip dial whose pre-activation wanders through the dip for a large share of tokens regardless of what they are, so any prompt of ~6+ tokens should be active and the short silent phrases are silent only because they are short; it should therefore be active on 'pdf docx xlsx' and 'cpu gpu ram ssd' (both measured 0.000, so this reading loses).

Fragment/format reading: the dip marks non-word surface material - subword fragments, non-Latin bytes, formatting punctuation and rare technical tokens - and the preposition/conjunction peaks are incidental; it should therefore be active on fragment-heavy strings but inactive on plain lowercase English compounds, whereas 'lorem ipsum' measures 0.998 and 'data science' 0.000.

Baadhi ya Wafanyakazi wa Kampuni ya Sahara Wakiongozwa Afisa Maendeleo ya Biashara Bi Mwajabu Mrutu (Watatu Kulia) Wakiwa Kwenye Kampeni ya Kuwasaidia Vijana wa Serengeti Boys ili kuweza kufanya Vizuri Kwenye Michuano ya Kombe la Afrika (AFCON -U17) Inayoendelea Nchini.
KAMPUNI ya Sahara Tanzania Limited imeamua kuanzisha kampeni ya kuwasaidia vijana wa Serengeti Boys kwa lengo la kuhakikisha wanafanya vema katika michuano ya Kombo la Africa (AFCON) chini ya miaka 17 inayoendelea nchini. Akizungmza leo Aprili 17, 2019 jijini Dar es Salaam Ofisa Maendeleo ya Biashara wa kampuni hiyo Mwajabu Mrutu amesema kampeni hiyo inajulikana kama ‘KeepYourEyeOnTheBall’ ambayo inatoa hamasa kwa vijana hao ili wajiamini na kufanya vizuri.Hivyo amesema kupitia kampeni hiyo, Sahara Tanzania Limited inatoa msaada wa kuwajengea uwezo vijana hao wa Serengeti wanaoshiriki AFCON 2019.
“Licha ya kuwa tunatoa hamasa kwa vijana katika kufanya vizuri siku za usoni, pia tunatoa mafunzo ya kuwajengea uwezo ili waweze kufanya vizuri zaidi,”amesema na kuongeza kampuni yao inatoa hudumu ya kuwapeleka wachezaji na mashambiki uwanjani kwa ajili ya kuwapa hamasa vijana wa Serengeti.Mrutu ametoa ombi kwa vyombo vya habari nchini na wadau wengine wakiwemo mashabiki wa Serengeti Boys kusaidia katika kutekeleza kampeni hiyo inayolenga kuwasaidia vijana.KeepYourEyeOnTheBall’ si ujumbe wa wachezaji tu, tunaamini ni ujumbe ambao unakuja wakati mwafaka kwa vijana wote wa Tanzania kwa ajili ya kupenda na kuhamasika katika suala la mpira wa miguu nchini Tanzania,”ameongeza Mrutu.
Wakati huo huo amesema kupitia kampeni hiyo, Sahara Tanzania Limited inatoa pia msaada wa masuala ya ujasiriamali na uchumi kwa ajili ya kuandaa wachezaji vijana kuona kama mpira ni sehemu nzuri ya kutengeneza maisha ya yao ya baadae.Tuna imani kuhusu vijana wa Tanzania na hii inatufanya Sahara tuendelee kutekeleza miradi mbalimbali ya kusaidia maendeleo endelevu kwa vijana wetu,” amesema.Amefafanua kuwa Sahara Tanzania Limited kupitia Sahara Foundation inatekeleza miradi mbalimbali nchini ukiwemo mradi wa kupandisha hadhi maabara katika Shule ya Sekondari Pugu inayohudumia wanafunzi zaidi ya 1000. Miradi mingine ni School Sanitation Wash and Hygiene (SWAH) ambao unahusisha utoaji wa vyoo na bafu katika shule ya Sekondari ya Salma Kikwete.

Najemnik zaś i ten, kto nie jest pasterzem, do którego owce nie należą, widząc nadchodzącego wilka, opuszcza owce i ucieka, a wilk je porywa i rozprasza. Najemnik ucieka dlatego, że jest najemnikiem i nie zależy mu na owcach. Ja jestem dobrym pasterzem i znam owce moje, a moje Mnie znają, podobnie jak Mnie zna Ojciec, a Ja znam Ojca. Życie moje oddaję za owce. Mam także inne owce, które nie są z tej owczarni. I te muszę przyprowadzić i będą słuchać głosu mego, i nastanie jedna owczarnia i jeden pasterz. Dlatego miłuje Mnie Ojciec, bo Ja życie moje oddaję, aby je potem znów odzyskać. Nikt mi go nie zabiera, lecz Ja od siebie je oddaję. Mam moc je oddać i mam moc je znów odzyskać. Taki nakaz otrzymałem od mojego Ojca”.
Czwarta Niedziela Wielkanocna nazywana jest NIEDZIELĄ DOBREGO PASTERZA. Nic więc dziwnego, że Kościół zaprasza nas do lektury fragmentu rozdziału 10. Ewangelii Janowej, w którym odnajdujemy najdoskonalszą syntezę obrazu Dobrego Pasterza. Został on stworzony przez Ewangelistę, który miał na uwadze starotestamentowe proroctwa o pasterzu Mesjaszu, szczególnie to z Ez 34, jak też tradycję nowotestamentową, dotyczącą czynów, które określały Jezusa jako wyjątkowego Pasterza, który zbierze stado rozproszone i odda za swoje owce życie. Kontemplacja obrazu Dobrego Pasterza pozwala nam odczytać ciągle aktualne PRZESŁANIE, KTÓRE STAJE SIĘ WYZWANIEM DLA KAŻDEGO UCZNIA CHRYSTUSA.
Cała dzisiejsza Ewangelia (J 10, 11-18) jest podana jako wypowiedź Jezusa, który wyraźnie utożsamia się z tym, o którym mówi.         $this->assertSame($finder, $finder->directories());
        $this->assertIterator($this->toAbsolute(array('foo', 'toto')), $finder->in(self::$tmpDir)->getIterator());

        $finder = $this->buildFinder();
        $finder->directories();
        $finder->files();
        $finder->directories();
        $this->assertIterator($this->toAbsolute(array('foo', 'toto')), $finder->in(self::$tmpDir)->getIterator());
    }

    public function testFiles()
    {
        $finder = $this->buildFinder();
        $this->assertSame($finder, $finder->files());
        $this->assertIterator($this->toAbsolute(array('foo/bar.tmp', 'test.php', 'test.py', 'foo bar')), $finder->in(self::$tmpDir)->getIterator());

        $finder = $this->buildFinder();
        $finder->files();

    }

    {
        $finder = $this->buildFinder();
        $this->assertSame($finder, $finder->depth('< 1'));
        $this->assertIterator($this->toAbsolute(array('foo', 'test.php', 'test.py', 'toto', 'foo bar')), $finder->in(self::$tmpDir)->getIterator());

        $finder = $this->buildFinder();
        $this->assertSame($finder, $finder->depth('<= 0'));
        $this->assertIterator($this->toAbsolute(array('foo', 'test.php', 'test.py', 'toto', 'foo bar')), $finder->in(self::$tmpDir)->getIterator());

        $this->assertIterator($this->toAbsolute(array('foo/bar.tmp')), $finder->in(self::$tmpDir)->getIterator());

        $finder = $this->buildFinder();
        $finder->depth('< 1')->depth('>= 1');
        $this->assertIterator(array(), $finder->in(self::$tmpDir)->getIterator());
    }

readings.explanation: N1499- reads out the neuron's GELU dip: its strength is |GELU(z)| of the pre-activation, so it saturates at 0.170 (GELU's exact floor) whenever z sits near -0.75 and returns to ~0 on both sides of that band, which is why all twenty top examples tie at 0.170 and why the same word reads 0.17 in one context and 0.00 in another. z is driven by phrase-boundary/functional material rather than by referential content: it drops into the band on an attached sentence-final period '.' or a newline '\r\n', and on prepositions/conjunctions (' of', ' in', ' and', ' or', ' to', ' from', ' on', ' by'), while it stays above the band on self-standing referential or technical tokens (pronouns/demonstratives such as 'this/those/you/it', determiner+noun compounds such as 'the cat', 'data science', 'pdf docx'); consequently any passage of running prose, code or non-Latin text of ~5+ tokens is active at 0.8-1.0 of max, and a probe is silent only when it is a short (2-6 token) punctuation-free phrase built from such referential/technical tokens.

Boundary-only reading: the negative pole is purely a sentence/line-end detector, so only clause-final punctuation or a newline can put it in the dip and the preposition/function-word peaks in the top examples are arbitrary tie-band members; it should therefore be silent on a punctuation-free sentence whatever its words, e.g. on 'The cat sat on the mat' (measured 0.69 of max, i.e. active, so this reading loses that probe).

Content-free dial reading: the pole is a default-on GELU-dip dial whose pre-activation wanders through the dip for a large share of tokens regardless of what they are, so any prompt of ~6+ tokens should be active and the short silent phrases are silent only because they are short; it should therefore be active on 'pdf docx xlsx' and 'cpu gpu ram ssd' (both measured 0.000, so this reading loses).

Fragment/format reading: the dip marks non-word surface material - subword fragments, non-Latin bytes, formatting punctuation and rare technical tokens - and the preposition/conjunction peaks are incidental; it should therefore be active on fragment-heavy strings but inactive on plain lowercase English compounds, whereas 'lorem ipsum' measures 0.998 and 'data science' 0.000.
